Potential risks: No partner or funding to conduct SCISMM assessments
Mitigation strategies: Identify needed assessment activities during the annual work planning process in order to budget for, identify and request funding from partners.

Potential risks: Master data are not identified as an essential building block in the current state assessment
Mitigation strategies: Conduct holistic assessments of the current HSCISs using SCISMM (16) to identify gaps in tools and governance and highlight impacts on interoperability, data quality, supply chain visibility and the ability to track and trace.

Potential risks: Some HSCISs are assigned too much priority for inclusion in the architecture while user adoption and efficacy are low
Mitigation strategies: Plan and perform assessments such as SCISMM (16) on an annual basis to analyse utilization gaps and identify ways to mitigate gaps through continuous user training and making utilization of systems the only way to perform processes.
